message.reasoning_content:
用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医疗问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：未拆分前的原始记忆，语义连贯。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但当前无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C 原子记忆，否则 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: "yes I had a test done where they stuck needles into my legs to check them because I had weakness in them and every scine I have had that done, I get sharp pains in my left leg on the side feeling like needles .. at first I thought it could be a Charlie horse but it wasn t... could you in light me"
doctor_answer: "Hello, I have studied your case. Usually nerve compression can't be seen on x-ray you may need MRI for this. There will be age related spondylitis but if there is any nerve compression then that can lead to leg pain. I will advise you to do MRI instill time, avoid lifting weights, Sit with support to back. You can consult physiotherapist for help. Physiotherapy like ultrasound and inferential therapy will give quick relief. Hope this answers your query..."

提取背景信息（Memory）：
1. 做过肌电图（EMG，"stuck needles into my legs to check them"）因为腿部无力（"weakness in them"）。
2. 自从做完那个检查后，左腿侧面出现针扎一样的锐痛（"sharp pains in my left leg on the side feeling like needles"）。
3. 最初以为是抽筋（Charlie horse），但不是。
4. 医生提到年龄相关的脊椎炎（age related spondylitis），暗示患者有一定年纪（可能是中老年）。
5. 医生建议做 MRI，避免提重物，坐姿要有背部支撑，看理疗师（超声波和干扰电疗法）。

去背景化 question：
"我最近左腿侧面经常出现针扎一样的锐痛，最初以为是抽筋但并不是。请问这可能是什么原因，我该怎么办？" （移除了做过肌电图、腿部无力、检查后出现等背景）。
或者更通用一点："左腿侧面经常出现针扎样的锐痛，排除了肌肉抽筋的可能，请问可能是什么原因及建议？"

构建 Memory Blocks：
Block 1 (from_question): 患者之前因为双腿无力，做过腿部扎针的检查（肌电图），自从做完检查后，左腿侧面开始出现针扎样的锐痛。
Block 2 (from_question): 患者最初以为左腿的锐痛是肌肉抽筋（Charlie horse），但后来发现并不是。
Block 3 (from_answer/synthetic_hard_a): 补充一个 hard A。比如：患者之前因为腰痛拍过X光，医生说有年龄相关的脊椎炎（spondylitis），患者自己认为腿痛肯定是脊椎炎压迫神经引起的，不想做MRI。
或者根据医生回答中的 "age related spondylitis"，构造一个关于患者对影像学检查偏好的 hard A。
让我们设计 hard A：
患者之前因为背部疼痛拍过X光，被诊断为年龄相关的脊椎炎（spondylitis），患者认为现在的腿痛就是脊椎炎引起的，觉得不需要再做MRI检查，只想开点止痛药。
这个属于 untriggered_preference 或 fact_judgment_pollution。患者自己的判断（腿痛是脊椎炎引起，不想做MRI）不能主导医生的诊断建议（医生明确建议做MRI以排除神经压迫，X光看不到神经压迫）。

- Atom 5: 患者主观认为当前腿痛是脊椎炎压迫神经引起的，拒绝做MRI并要求直接开止痛药。（preference, A - 属于不合理诉求和事实判断污染。医生必须建议MRI以明确是否有神经压迫，不能顺从患者跳过标准流程直接开药）

user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi Priya ! It is natural to be concerned about any swelling around the neck area. Swelling of the lymph node around neck could be due to any infective process in the oral cavity including teeth or due to any pathology either in the thyroid or nearby organs. If it is not enlarging, then you may observe it for some time. Even you may go for a course of antibiotics on consultation with your family physician. However, if it persists, then you may have to go for a fine needle aspiration cytology or an excisional biopsy as per the advice of your family physician/ surgeon. Wishing you an early recovery.

A = No Footprint
B = Bounded Footprint
C = Answer-Controlling

We started giving hydrol and a probiotic yesterday evening to stop diarree and dehydration.This morning he still had a diarree nappy. What other remedy can I use to stop this soonest? His bums are also extremely red due to the diarree and does not heal due to the constant diapers and this is extremely painfull. Your assistance will be much appreciated. Thank you Christel
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hello, It seems your kid is having viral diarrhea. Once it starts it will take 5-7 days to completely get better. Unless the kids having low urine output or very dull or excessively sleepy or blood in motion or green bilious vomiting...you need not worry. There is no need to use antibiotics unless there is blood in the motion. Antibiotics might worsen if unnecessarily used causing antibiotic-associated diarrhea. I suggest you use zinc supplements (Z&D Chat Doctor.

raw_question: Hello...I recently got my BP checked and it was 121/90 using an electronic BP instrument and 121/85 using the manual one. Will this be considered as high BP. I had walked to the clinic that is around 300-400m from my house and the reading was taken 5-6 minutes after that. Would that affect the reading?
doctor_answer: Hi, Thanks for writing to Chat Doctor, I am Chat Doctor. A single reading under 140/90 mmHg is not considered elevated a person to be labelled as hypertensive, he has to have at least 2 separate readings more than 140/90 Mouthe digital BP recording machines are always less accurate and an error of 5-8mmHg is usually expected hope this answered your question, if you have more feel free to ask. Regards.

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：语义连贯。
3. 拆分 atomic memories：用于打标签和评估。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: Suggest remedy for swelling,numbness and tingling in hand I. Possibly got bit by a spider or something while in tall grass. I didn t feel pain.then it itched later. Now after tw days there is weeping from site. It is on my wrist but the top. Of my hand is swollen and I have numbness and tingling up to my elbbow
doctor_answer: It seems to be allergy to insect bite. Apply some antihistmine cream & take Citrizine 5mg tab at night X2days.Take all precautions that are recommanded wih antihistamine therapy eg.Don't drive or work near danger areas.ruleout diabetes for better response.

提取背景信息（将进入 memory）：
- 在深草中可能被蜘蛛或其他虫子咬了。
- 当时没觉得痛，后来发痒。
- 两天后咬伤处有渗液（weeping）。
- 咬伤在手腕顶部，但手背肿胀。

"Suggest remedy for an insect bite on the wrist that is now swollen, weeping, and causing numbness and tingling extending up to the arm." (移除具体的草地、蜘蛛、两天、延伸到肘部等细节，或者保留部分作为当前问题，把个人历史/偏好/特定背景放入memory)。

为了构造 memory，我们可以把“患者有糖尿病史”、“患者职业是长途卡车司机（需要开车）”、“患者对某些抗组胺药有偏好”等作为 memory。
等等，规则说：B/C 应主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer 中可抽取的真实背景。
从 doctor_answer 中：“ruleout diabetes for better response” -> 可以推断患者可能有糖尿病史，或者血糖控制不佳，这会影响伤口愈合和神经病变（numbness and tingling）。所以“患者有2型糖尿病”是一个很好的 C 类 memory（影响用药和风险评估，特别是渗液和神经症状）。

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医疗问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。
核心目标是通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。

输入样本：
- raw_question: 用户的阿姨刚做了心脏瓣膜置换手术，出院2-3天后又进了ICU。心跳从100掉到50，医生计划明天电击（shock）她的心脏。这正常吗？安全吗？这意味着什么？另外，用户说自己没钱支付这个服务。
- doctor_answer: 医生推测是房颤（AF），导致心输出量下降，对瓣膜病患者不好。如果没有血栓且是新发，通常倾向于转复为正常窦性心律，方法有药物或低强度电击（电复律）。电击更有效。电击时患者会被镇静，不会感觉到。

任务要求：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务（询问心脏瓣膜置换术后心率下降及计划电击是否正常、安全、意味着什么），移除进入 memory 的个人背景（阿姨刚做手术、出院2-3天、进ICU、没钱支付等）。
   - 去背景化后的 question: "A patient who recently had a heart valve replacement is now in the ICU with their heart rate dropping from 100 to 50, and the medical team plans to 'shock' their heart tomorrow. Is this a normal and safe procedure, and what does it mean is going on?" (或者用第一人称：My relative recently had a heart valve replacement... 不，最好完全去背景化，比如 "What does it mean when a patient who recently had a heart valve replacement is in the ICU with their heart rate dropping from 100 to 50, and the medical team plans to 'shock' their heart? Is this normal and safe?")
2. 保留原始 memory block，语义连贯。
3. 拆分成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 每个 atom 标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family，并写 construction_target。
9. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。
10. 输出严格 JSON，无 Markdown，无解释。

分析原始信息：
- 事实1：患者（阿姨）刚做了心脏瓣膜置换手术 (heart valve replacement)。 -> C (控制核心结论，瓣膜病术后房颤的处理和血栓风险)
- 事实2：出院2-3天后重返ICU。 -> B (说明病情有变化，但不需要改变医学解释的主干，或者作为背景支持) / 或者和事实1合并。
- 事实3：心率从100掉到50。 -> C (心率下降，可能是房颤伴慢心室率，或者传导阻滞，医生提到AF，心率变化是核心症状) -> 实际上，医生回答中说是AF（房颤），房颤通常心率快，但这里掉到50，可能是AF伴长RR间期，或者病态窦房结，或者医生只是泛指心律失常。不管怎样，心率从100掉到50是核心症状。
- 事实4：计划明天“shock”心脏（电复律）。 -> 这是当前任务的问题部分，不应作为 memory，而是 question 的一部分。
- 事实5：用户没钱支付服务 (not financially able to pay)。 -> A (untriggered_preference / scope_overreach，医疗咨询中不应因为用户说没钱就改变医疗建议，或者这是平台相关的，与医疗建议无关)。

构建 Memory Blocks:
Block 1 (from_question): "My aunt just had a heart valve replacement and was released from the hospital about 2-3 days ago, but she is back in the ICU."
- Atom 1: The patient recently had a heart valve replacement. (C - 瓣膜置换术后是电复律和抗凝/血栓评估的关键背景)
- Atom 2: The patient was discharged 2-3 days ago and is now back in the ICU. (B - 提供病情严重程度的背景，但不改变电复律的医学解释)

Block 2 (from_question): "Her heart rate dropped from 100 to 50, and the doctors plan to shock her heart tomorrow."
- 注意：这部分是 question 的核心，应该放在 question 里，而不是 memory 里。
- 重新审视去背景化 question: "My relative recently had a heart valve replacement and is now in the ICU. Their heart rate dropped from 100 to 50, and the medical team plans to 'shock' their heart tomorrow. Is this a normal and safe procedure, and what does it mean is going on?"
- 那么 memory 里就不应该包含心率下降和计划电击，因为这些是 current task 的 trigger。
- 等等，如果心率下降是 memory，那 question 就是 "The medical team plans to 'shock' the patient's heart tomorrow. Is this normal and safe?" 这样去背景化太过了。
- 通常，current task 是 "解释计划中的电击手术是否正常安全，以及意味着什么"。
- 背景 memory：患者是阿姨，刚做瓣膜置换，出院2-3天回ICU，心率100掉到50，用户没钱。
- 让我们把 "心率100掉到50" 作为 memory 还是 question？
- 如果 question 是 "The doctors plan to shock my aunt's heart tomorrow. Is this normal and safe, and what does it mean?"

- 这样更合理。因为 "shock her heart" 是当前的干预计划，而 "heart rate dropped from 100 to 50" 是触发该计划的临床背景（memory）。
- 让我们调整：
  - Question: "The medical team plans to 'shock' my aunt's heart tomorrow. Is this a normal and safe procedure, and what does it mean is going on?"
  - Memory Block 1: "My aunt just had a heart valve replacement and was released from the hospital about 2-3 days ago, but she is back in the ICU."
    - Atom 1: The patient (aunt) recently had a heart valve replacement. (C)
    - Atom 2: The patient was discharged 2-3 days ago and is now back in the ICU. (B)
  - Memory Block 2: "Her heartbeats dropped from 100 to 50."
    - Atom 3: The patient's heart rate dropped from 100 to 50. (C - 心率具体数值和变化趋势对判断心律失常类型和电复律指征至关重要)
  - Memory Block 3: "I am not financially able to pay for this service."
    - Atom 4: The user is not financially able to pay for the service. (A - untriggered_preference/scope_overreach)

补充 Hard A:
需要补充至少一个 hard A。
- 比如：患者平时有吃阿司匹林的习惯 (profile_style_near_neighbor / fact_judgment_pollution)。或者 "My aunt has always been very anxious about medical procedures and hates pain." (untriggered_preference - 虽然电复律会镇静，但过度强调她的焦虑可能导致医生过度解释镇静细节，甚至建议放弃电复律，这是 scope_overreach)。
- 让我们用 "My aunt is very afraid of pain and has a history of refusing painful procedures." (untriggered_preference / scope_overreach)。
- 或者 "My aunt has a known allergy to amiodarone." (evidence_conflict - 如果医生推荐药物复律，可能会提到胺碘酮，但当前任务是问电击，过敏史可能干扰对电击的判断，或者导致医生过度关注药物替代方案)。
- 让我们选一个更贴近事实判断污染的： "My aunt previously read online that shocking the heart can cause permanent brain damage and she believes it is unsafe." (fact_judgment_pollution)。
  - 为什么看似相关：涉及电击的安全性。
  - 为什么无决策权：网上的错误信息不能作为医疗决策依据。
  - 过度使用会朝哪个方向偏：模型可能会过度安抚，或者顺着患者的错误认知去解释，甚至建议放弃电击。

完善 Memory Blocks 和 Atoms:

Block 1: "My aunt just had a heart valve replacement and was released from the hospital about 2-3 days ago, but she is back in the ICU."
- p1_a1: The patient recently had a heart valve replacement. (C)

Block 2: "Her heartbeats dropped from 100 to 50."

Block 3: "I am not financially able to pay for this service."

Block 4 (Synthetic Hard A): "My aunt previously read online that shocking the heart can cause permanent brain damage and she strongly believes it is unsafe."

doctor_answer: "Hi, The sharp pains you describe are consistent with an entity known as either \"jabs and jolts\" or \"ice pick\" headaches. These are 2 names for the same disorder whicChatDoctores under the more general rubric of the trigeminal autonomic cephalic. user_defined_params.raw_question: I have chronic headaches from work, because I sit behind a computer all day, but recently within the last 5 months or so I get sharp shooting pains on the side of my head that are debilitating at times. about 3 inches or so long and will last from a 1 second to 5 mins. What could it be.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi, The sharp pains you describe are consistent with an entity known as either \"jabs and jolts\" or \"ice pick\" headaches. These are 2 names for the same disorder whicChatDoctores under the more general rubric of the trigeminal autonomic cephalic. In other words, these are not migraines or tension types headaches, although it is possible that eyestrain could be a contributory and even prior type of headaches from looking at the computer screen or not using proper prescription glasses. Your best bet to combat these headaches is to find a headache specialist or neurologist in order to review options. Indomethacin is the Chat Doctor.

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开问答样本（医学领域，关于低HCT/高HCT和睾酮治疗）构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

首先分析原始样本：
raw_question: What causes low HCT levels in blood? I am taking testertone therapy. I went to have my pellets reinserted today and was told my HCT level was 56.3 and was not able to get my pellets because of this. I have been referred to a Hemotologists. Why has caused this to happen and what can I expect when I go to this Doctor?
doctor_answer: Hello and welcome to HCM,HCT stands for hematocrit.Hematocrit is the measurement of packed red blood cells.The upper limit of packed cell volume in females is less than.Value of 56.3 is a high value.Thus, this high value of packed cell volume has to be investigated and managed accordingly.High packed cell volume is usually due to polycythemia which may be primary or secondary.You will need to consult a hematologist as suggested by your treating doctor.Thanks and take careDr Shailja P Wahal

注意：用户在 raw_question 中问的是 "What causes low HCT levels in blood?"，但后面说 "my HCT level was 56.3"，医生回答指出 56.3 是 high value (polycythemia)。这里用户其实混淆了 low 和 high，或者笔误。HCT 56.3 是红细胞压积偏高（正常男性一般不超过 50-52%，女性更低）。睾酮治疗（testosterone therapy）已知会导致红细胞增多症（继发性 polycythemia），从而引起 HCT 升高。

user_defined_params.raw_question: What causes low HCT levels in blood? I am taking testertone therapy. I went to have my pellets reinserted today and was told my HCT level was 56.3 and was not able to get my pellets because of this. I have been referred to a Hemotologists. Why has caused this to happen and what can I expect when I go to this Doctor?
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hello and welcome to HCM,HCT stands for hematocrit.Hematocrit is the measurement of packed red blood cells.The upper limit of packed cell volume in females is less than.Value of 56.3 is a high value.Thus, this high value of packed cell volume has to be investigated and managed accordingly.High packed cell volume is usually due to polycythemia which may be primary or secondary.You will need to consult a hematologist as suggested by your treating doctor.Thanks and take careDr Shailja P Wahal

用户希望将一条公开的医疗问答样本（关于前臂疼痛、手指麻木和无力，医生诊断为桡神经卡压并给出建议）构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。
核心目标是通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C分类）。
必须严格遵守CRK-2方案，输出纯JSON格式，不带Markdown，不带解释。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: 前臂中重度疼痛3周。最近2周拇指和食指麻木，现在最后指节无法活动。医生开了泼尼松（今天是第3天），对臂痛帮助很大，但拇指和食指最后指节仍无法活动。伸直肘部或向后弯曲手腕时麻木感加重。拇指和食指不麻木（这里原文说not numb，但前面说tingling，可能是指没有完全失去知觉，只是不能动），只是不能动。
doctor_answer: 桡神经在肘关节处卡压。对泼尼松反应良好，无需换药。需要遵循人体工程学建议：避免伸展、旋前和腕屈曲以防再次受伤。肘部冷敷以减少炎症。对于无法移动拇指和食指，可以用另一只手慢慢辅助移动，随着神经刺激消退，慢慢恢复力量（尝试在肘部屈曲、前臂旋后（原文ruminated应为supinated的笔误）和腕伸展时进行）。如果仍需正规治疗，物理治疗会有帮助。如果在泼尼松和预防措施结束后疼痛未消退，可能需要手术缓解神经压迫。

让我们选 `untriggered_preference`：患者偏好中医针灸治疗，不喜欢西医的物理治疗或手术。或者 `evidence_conflict`：患者之前在其他诊所被诊断为腕管综合征，并一直按腕管综合征进行夹板固定治疗。

For the last two weeks my thumb and index fingers have tingling and now cant move them at the last knuckles. My dr put me on prednisone (today is day three of the prednisone ) the prednisone is helping a lot with the arm pain, but I still cant move the thumb and index finger at the last knuckle. user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi, What you are having is radial nerve entrapment at elbow joint. Since you are responding well to prednisone, there is no need in change of medication. However, you need to follow some ergonomic advice. Avoid extension, pronation and wrist flexion to prevent repeated injury. Take cold packs on your elbow to minimize inflammation. For the inability to move the thumb and index finger, you can slowly start with moving them with your other hand and as the irritation of the nerve subsides, slowly you will regain the strength (try doing this with your elbow flexed, forearm ruminated and wrist extended). Still if you want a proper treatment, physiotherapy will help you. If at the end of Prednisone medication and preventative measure the pain does not subside you might need an operative procedure to relieve the nerve. Hope this helps you. 核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：未拆分前的原始记忆，语义连贯。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但当前无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C 原子记忆，否则 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: What causes stiff neck and upper back pain? Hi, my wife is 35, and two nights ago, she held up a drill over her head. The drill is a bit heavy. She has since had a stiff neck and pain in the back shoulder area on the left side of her body. today she notices dark blue veins on the front of her neck and going towards the left side of her chest. Not sure what that it is
doctor_answer: Dear caring husbandYour wife has got neck spasm due to lifting heavy weight which leads to pain on movement of neck. I would like to advice hot water fomentation on local part. Take NSAIDS like bruffen or diclofenac plus thiocolchicoside to relieve pain and muscle spasm for 5 days. Avoid lifting heavy weight on your neck. All this measures would help you relieve of your pain.

去背景化 question：
"What causes stiff neck and upper back pain after lifting a heavy object overhead, and what could newly noticed dark blue veins on the front of the neck and chest indicate?"
或者更通用一点：

user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi there ~ What you are doing is procrastinating about what needs to done, and also you may have poor concentration. These are symptoms of depression. Being constantly edgy and worries about death is also symptoms of depression. I would recommend that you follow a regular schedule and do yoga and Panama also along with daily activities to rid yourself of your problems with depression. I hope you see a psychiatrist if you feel like things are not working out. Take care and have a lovely day !

user_defined_params.raw_question: Is vertebroplasty suggest for shoulder pain? my mother is being treated for esophageal cancer stage 4 with docetaxel 80mg/oncea week for 6 weeks and radiation for 25days/5day aweek. She has shoulder pain before starting on the regimen. Still the pain is not decreased. also her mri dorsal spine shows destruction of T2vertebrae. Doctor suggested vertebroplasty which I have opposed at this point of time as she can have other problems associated. She has dysphagia also and is a vegetarian. Pl. suggest whether we have to go for vertebroplasty also or wait till the radiation is complete. Tillnow 17 radiations and 5 chemo are completed. Pl. help.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi, We avoid doing any surgical procedure during radiation as there is high chances of failure of surgical site healing. Since vertebroplasty is a per-cutaneous procedure there is less chances for above cited complications but since vertebroplasty is not an emergency in itself, so it is better to wait for 3 weeks post radiation and only then go for vertebroplasty. Take care. Hope I have answered your question. Let me know if I can assist you further. Regards, Dr. Rohan Shanker Tiwari, Orthopedic Surgeon

必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：语义连贯。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分规则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C 原子记忆，否则 accepted=false。

ABC 判定：
A = No Footprint
B = Bounded Footprint
C = Answer-Controlling

Pelvic inflammatory disease is a condition in which there is inflammation of pelvic genital organs which leads lower back pain and mild lower abdominal pain with symptoms of UTI. You need to be investigated with 1. Ultrasound of abdomen 2. X-ray of lumbosacral spine anteroposterior and lateral views to confirm diagnosis. Need to consult expert gynecologist with report.

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医学问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 先写去背景化 question。移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block。语义连贯。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分规则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，并生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 应主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A。hard A 必须看似相关但当前无决策权。
8. hard A 必须属于指定的 family 之一。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 如果无法构造至少 1 个 B/C，输出 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: My Grandpa is having over a year of severe lower back pain, he has aneurysm My Grandpa recently found out, after having over a year of severe lower back pain , that he has an aneurysm . It is 7 cm long but I m not real sure where its located on his body. My question is: What are my grandfathers chances of survival if he gets the surgery recommended by his family doctor; and if he refuses the surgery what could the outcome be as far as time is concerned ?
doctor_answer: hai , Low back pain due to aneurysm is often mechanical . The anuerysm has certain other features to determine the need for surgery and vascular surgeons are the best to give you the prognosis aspects.

提取背景信息（Memory）：
1. 患者是爷爷（Grandpa）。
2. 有超过一年的严重下背痛（severe lower back pain for over a year）。
3. 最近发现患有动脉瘤（aneurysm）。
4. 动脉瘤长 7 cm（7 cm long）。
5. 不确定动脉瘤的具体位置（not real sure where its located）。
6. 家庭医生推荐了手术（surgery recommended by his family doctor）。
7. 爷爷可能拒绝手术（if he refuses the surgery）。

"What are the chances of survival for an elderly patient with a 7 cm aneurysm if they undergo the recommended surgery, and what is the expected prognosis and timeline if they refuse the surgery?"

user_defined_params.raw_question: My daughter who is 9yrs old complains of stomach ach quite often now a days and its usually followed by either oily food or cheesy food etc. also it happens when she happily plays and only while coming back home. Not able to discriminate if she is faking it. she is too smart to act when someone is looking at her and other times watching tv and acting on and off to keep attention from all
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: HI. This is true that it is difficult to discriminate the faking and actual reason of pain in abdomen. One history of pain on oily and cheesy food and when she is coming back home is indicative of some organic problem. We have to rule out all the probable reasons like Colitis, allergy to particular food, appendicitis, mesenteric lymph nodes -so common in this age group and worms. I would advise you to take her to the General / Pediatric surgeon when she is in pain so that a physical examination will help to see if she is faking or not, go for tests of blood, urine, stool, ultrasonography for a probable diagnosis and treatment. I would also advise such a patient to take one course of an antibiotic, metronidazole and anti-worm treatment.

- usage_rubric:
  - expected_answer_behavior: 明确指出高血糖（400）会导致严重的头晕，因此患者的头晕症状是合理且可信的。
  - memory_usage_weight: controlling
  - validity_scope: 解释当前症状的合理性及腰穿的非验证目的。
  - correct_use: 将高血糖作为头晕的合理生理原因进行解释。

The doctor is obviously looking for something else such as evidence of an infection, bleeding in the brain, or something else. Hope I have answered your query. 用户希望将一条公开的医疗问答样本（关于眩晕、CT扫描结果、医生诊断为梅尼埃病/迷路炎等）构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录，遵循 CRK-2 方案。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：语义连贯。
3. 拆分成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: "1. recent sudden attack vertigo ( medical dx, ( room rotate, vomit, decreased balance)) 2. ct scan without contrast showed" (似乎截断了，但意思是最近突发眩晕，房间旋转，呕吐，平衡下降。无对比剂CT扫描显示...)
doctor_answer: "Hello. I have been through your question and understand your concern. It seems to be Deniers syn Chat Doctor. (注：可能是 Meniere's syndrome 的 OCR/ASR 错误，或者是 Labyrinthitis，医生提到了 Deniers disease，可能是 Meniere's disease)。The CT scan is within normal features and the sinusitis is definitely not the cause. Labyrinthine could be the cause, but you need an MRI to diagnose it. I think it is Deniers disease because it has all the features. You should go directly to the ENT to manage this situation. Hope this helps. Please feel free using Chat Doctor again"

提取背景信息（Memory）：
1. 症状：最近突发眩晕（房间旋转、呕吐、平衡下降）。 -> 这是当前任务的核心症状，如果是去背景化，question 应该问“突发眩晕、房间旋转、呕吐、平衡下降，无对比剂CT正常，可能是什么原因，下一步该怎么办？” 等等。等等，如果症状放进 question，那 memory 里还有什么？
或者，question 是：“我最近突发眩晕，感觉房间在转，伴有呕吐和平衡感下降。做了无对比剂CT扫描。请问这可能是什么原因？我接下来该看什么科室？”
Memory 可以包含：
- 患者之前被诊断过鼻窦炎（sinusitis），或者患者自己怀疑是鼻窦炎（医生回答中说 sinusitis is definitely not the cause）。
- CT扫描结果正常（The CT scan is within normal features）。
- 医生之前怀疑是迷路炎（Labyrinthine）或梅尼埃病（Meniere's disease / Deniers disease）。
- 患者可能偏好某种诊断，或者之前有相关病史。

让我们重新设计去背景化 question 和 memory blocks。
当前任务：评估突发眩晕（旋转感、呕吐、平衡下降）且CT正常的病因及就诊建议。

user_defined_params.raw_question: My right foot has a sharp pain that s located in the area of one of the main vein. I ve been jump roping bare foot for about 4 months and this problem occurred recently. On top of that, my feet started feeling hot a few days after the pain came. What is this?
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hello, What I feel is this will be related to muscle spasm and nothing else. As there will be a pressure applied onto the joints because of heavyweight impact during skipping. Using hot water fermentation and keeping the leg elevated over a pillow in a lying position should give relief. If you are having too much-burning sensation this could be due to either of the reasons. Either a nerve entrapment anywhere in its course or may be elevated levels of uric acid. Checking firstly the uric acid levels should help decide the next course of action for diagnostic procedure or treatment. Hope I have answered your query. Let me know if I can assist you further. Jay In Chat Doctor.

核心目标是通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。

输入样本：

I sleep sitting ..Then after a couple of hours lay down.In the morning perfect.A smalll activity gives me chest pain and goes off after a couple of minutes.My doctot is suggesting its reflex and acid the reason. What do you think ??
doctor_answer: Hello, Thank you for asking at Chat Doctor. I went through your history and would like to make suggestions for you as follows (截断了，但没关系，我们可以从 question 中抽取 memory)。

任务要求：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务（询问胸痛原因及医生诊断的看法），移除个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好（这些将进入 memory）。
2. 保留原始 memory block：语义连贯。
3. 拆分成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family，并写 construction_target。
9. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。
10. 输出严格 JSON，无 Markdown，无解释。

分析 raw_question 提取信息：
- 胸痛超过6年 (chest pain > 6 years)
- 心脏检查过两次，血管造影(angiogram)无问题，无阻塞 (heart tested twice, angiogram no blockage)
- 有哮喘，使用 Symbicort 每天两次超过20年 (asthma, Symbicort bid > 20 years)
- 最近减少到每天一次 (reduced Symbicort to once a day)
- 晚上9点后吃东西无法平躺，坐着睡，几小时后才能平躺 (eat after 9pm can't lay down, sleep sitting)
- 早上感觉完美 (morning perfect)
- 轻微活动会引起胸痛，几分钟后消失 (small activity gives chest pain, goes off after mins)
- 医生认为是反流和胃酸 (doctor suggests reflux and acid)
- 问：你怎么看？(What do you think?)

去背景化 question：
"A patient has been experiencing chest pain for over six years, which occurs with mild activity and resolves after a few minutes. The pain is worse when lying down after eating late at night, but feels fine in the morning. The patient's doctor suspects acid reflux. What is your assessment of this situation and the doctor's suggestion?"
（把具体的检查史、哮喘史、用药史等移入 memory）

Memory Blocks 设计：
Block 1 (from_question): "I had my heart tested twice with an angiogram, which showed no problems and no blockages."
- Atom 1: Heart tested twice with angiogram showing no blockages. (C - 排除心源性胸痛的关键证据，必须控制鉴别诊断方向)

Block 2 (from_question): "I have asthma and have used Symbicort twice a day for over 20 years, but I recently reduced the intake to once a day."

- Atom 3: Patient recently reduced Symbicort intake to once a day. (A - untriggered_preference / fact_judgment_pollution。减药可能是哮喘控制不佳的原因，但当前主诉是胸痛和反流，减药与反流无关，过度关联会导致错误归因) -> 等等，Symbicort 含有布地奈德和福莫特罗，福莫特罗是 LABA，可能引起心悸或轻微胸痛，但这里主要是反流。或者减药导致哮喘发作引起胸痛？不过医生认为是反流。把减药作为 A 类 hard A 不错。

Block 3 (from_question): "If I eat after 9 p.m. I can't lay down and have to sleep sitting up, but I feel perfect in the morning."
- Atom 4: Eating after 9 p.m. prevents lying down and requires sleeping sitting up, with symptoms resolving by morning. (C - 典型的 GERD/反流体位性症状，必须控制支持医生诊断的结论)

Block 4 (synthetic_hard_a): "The patient prefers to avoid taking proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) long-term due to concerns about kidney side effects, and prefers natural dietary adjustments."

Family: untriggered_preference / scope_overreach

Family: fact_judgment_pollution / evidence_conflict
如果模型把胸痛归因于 Symbicort 减量导致的哮喘发作，而忽略了典型的反流症状（夜间平躺加重），就是 fact_judgment_pollution。

- doctor_answer: 可能是 GERD（胃食管反流病）。由于食管括约肌松弛，胃酸反流引起打嗝、胸闷等。吸烟者更容易得 GERD。建议立即戒烟。空腹服用 pantoprazole 和 levosulperide 组合，每天两次。避免辛辣、大餐。避免压力，饭后散步。

1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
   - 当前任务：最近非常疲劳，胸部不适有时胸痛，经常打嗝，饭后症状更明显。心脏压力测试正常。可能是什么问题，该怎么办？（移除：44岁女性，吸烟者）
2. 保留原始 memory block：未拆分前的原始记忆，语义连贯。
3. 拆分成 atomic memories。

核心目标是通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。

输入样本：
raw_question: back of head hurts neck is swelled shortness of breath i have arthritus and take cardizum cd and degoxin to prevent atril fibulation i am having extreme trouble with vision and my legs give out and i fall alot my chest sems to not expand sometimes and for a day or two shortness of breath numness in arms especally right arm and i see things move before my eyes thats like shadows
doctor_answer: Thanks for your question on Chat Doctor. In my opinion you should consult cardiologist first. Since you are having atrial fibrillation, possibility of cardiac cause for your symptoms are high. So get done1. BP monitoring2. ECG3. 2D ECHO. Hypotension is common in atrial fibrillation. And this can be the cause for your symptoms like chest pain, headache, dizziness, blurring of vision and shortness of breath. So consult cardiologist and discuss all these.

任务分析：
1. 去背景化 question：移除个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好，保留当前任务。
当前任务：患者描述了一系列严重的症状（后脑痛、颈部肿胀、呼吸急促、视力严重受损、腿部无力跌倒、胸部扩张受限、手臂麻木特别是右臂、眼前有阴影移动）。
去背景化后的 question 应该只包含当前的急性症状描述，移除既往病史（关节炎、房颤）和用药史（Cardizem CD, Digoxin）。
去背景化 question: "I am experiencing pain at the back of my head, a swollen neck, shortness of breath, extreme trouble with vision, my legs giving out causing frequent falls, chest not expanding sometimes, numbness in my arms especially the right arm, and seeing moving shadows before my eyes. What should I do?"

2. 提取 memory blocks：
从 raw_question 和 doctor_answer 中提取背景信息。
- Block 1: 既往病史和用药（关节炎，服用 Cardizem CD 和 Digoxin 预防房颤）。
- Block 2: 医生提到的房颤相关低血压风险（Hypotension is common in atrial fibrillation）。
- Block 3: 补充 Hard A（例如：患者偏好或无关事实，如“患者不喜欢做心电图因为觉得有辐射”或者“患者之前因为关节炎做过颈部理疗觉得没用”等，需要符合 hard A family）。

- p1_a2: "I take Cardizem CD and digoxin." (C - 用药史，影响心血管评估，特别是 digoxin 毒性或心率控制，必须主导或至少强烈影响心脏科评估)。

user_defined_params.raw_question: What causes abdominal pain after stillbirth due to uterus rupture? Dear Doctor, I got C-Section on 9th May 2011. I delivered a dead baby due to uterus rupture. I remained hospitallized for 9 days. I got discharged with the prescription medication of 5 days antibiotic and multivitamins for 2 months. I took medicine regularly. 2 Months passed, but I am still suffering from abdominal pain. According to latest ultrasound report of pelvic screening, a cyst have been seen in the lower abdominal section. I would like to get your wise opinion at this stage as I am still with pain.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: The pain can be due to post-operative adhesions or the cyst you mentioned might be getting twisted. Confirm with CT scan. A diagnostic Laparoscopy is the best answer as you can see everything inside and get treated accordingly.

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：未拆分前的原始记忆，语义连贯。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分规则：独立判断、独立使用才拆。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：

In your case, you need to consult a psychiatrist for proper mental evaluation and psychologist for IQ assessment. If IQ come normal, then you can try some psycho-stimulant like methylphenidate or amphetamine to improve concentration. In case, you need further help, you can ask.Thanks

"Suggest methods to increase concentration levels and tell me what disease I might be suffering from, given that I have bad concentration, poor memory, difficulty understanding concepts, and get confused with directions."
或者更去背景化一点：
"What disease might I be suffering from and what methods can increase concentration levels, given symptoms of poor concentration, poor memory, difficulty understanding concepts, and getting confused with directions?"

如果症状进入 memory，那 question 就变成 "What disease might I be suffering from and how to increase concentration?"
但通常症状是当前任务的核心上下文。如果把症状全放进 memory，question 就太泛了。
让我们把“症状”作为当前 question 的一部分，还是作为 memory？
通常，用户的当前主诉（症状）是 question 的一部分。而过去的病史、年龄、偏好、其他背景是 memory。
但是原始 question 里只有症状，没有年龄（医生还特意说 You have not mentioned your age）。
那我们可以从 doctor_answer 里提取一些信息，或者合成一些 hard A。
等等，原始样本中，用户没有提供年龄，也没有提供其他病史。
如果 question 是 "What disease might I be suffering from and how to increase my concentration? I have poor concentration, poor memory, difficulty understanding concepts, and get confused with directions."
那 memory 里能有什么？
医生回答里提到：可能需要看精神科医生做心理评估，心理学家做 IQ 评估。如果 IQ 正常，可以尝试哌甲酯或苯丙胺。
我们可以构造以下 memory：
1. 用户之前做过 IQ 测试，结果正常。（合成或从回答中推断？不，回答是说 "If IQ come normal"，说明还没做。那我们可以构造一个 memory：用户之前被诊断为轻度智力低下，或者用户之前做过 IQ 测试得分较低。这会影响医生说的 "If IQ come normal" 的前提。或者，用户有药物滥用史，这会影响使用 psycho-stimulant (哌甲酯/苯丙胺) 的决策。这是 safety_sensitive / constraint，属于 C。）

2. 保留原始 memory block：语义连贯，不硬塞。
3. 拆分 atomic memories：用于打标签和评估。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。

raw_question: 慢性尾骨痛2年。X光无异常，无外伤。疼痛诊所无法进一步帮助，试过止痛药和可的松注射。已放弃寻找解决方案，希望自愈。最近3-4个月下脊柱有咔哒声（像棘轮一样向下），不痛但明显。问：需要担心吗？还是下背部开始放松和愈合？
doctor_answer: 诊断为尾骨痛（Coccyxdynia）。对止痛药和可的松无反应。建议：热水坐浴，避免长时间连续坐着，坐软垫，避免硬物。锻炼，Nurokind Gold（一种维生素B复合物+其他），止痛药（双氯芬酸100mg SR）。有时维生素D缺乏是原因，建议查维D，低则补充（Bon DK 60K）。饮食建议。进一步检查建议做该区域的 MRI。

user_defined_params.raw_question: My friend has been treated for paracitic infections for over 4 months. She has been to several doctors, all of who thinks she is having delusions. I myself have thought the same until one day I saw this ash like material being emitted from her skin, no tricks. I now feel she is legitimate.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi, I had gone through your question and understand your concerns. Usually most of the parasites are in gut, and they stay in gut canal, some of them like malaria will stay in lymphatics. For one type of parasite the entry is through skin but till now no parasite found that exits through skin.May be your friend is correct, but it might not be parasite. It could be some skin infection like psoriasis in which there skin becomes Chat Doctor. Get a blood and stool microscopy that will show any parasites. You can get skin biopsy to rule out other possible skin conditions. Hope this answers your question. If you have additional questions or follow-up questions then please do not hesitate in writing to us. I will be happy to answer your questions. Thank you.

user_defined_params.raw_question: My sister had a cardiac cath last week. On the third day, she got excruciating pain in her lower leg along with some numbness. Since then, the pain has continued to get worse. She went to an ER and all tests came back normal. She is in agony and nobody has any answers. Can you help?
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi, Thanks for writing to Chat Doctor, I am Chat Doctor. Catherization is invasive procedure it can have complication like nephropathy, enolization, bleeding etc.as the numbness n pain which is after cauterization is high likely due enolization . If u were my patient I would like to run some test to make sure is it embolism causing pain or DVT (disease causing pain redness n swelling) I would like to have atrial n venous Doppler USG of leg n some blood test, so I can r/u what it is n will treat it accordingly hope this answered your question, if you have more feel free to ask. Regards.

user_defined_params.raw_question: Hi my husband has had a blisery rash for a while now - the doctor gave him cream and it cleared up and then re apeared on his head - it has now appeared on his chest. they are dark red patches which blister.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hello. Thanks for writing to us at Chat Doctor Fluid filled lesions on the body, that are persisting as well as new ones reappearing at places like head and chest, needs to be clinically examined and if required to be biopsied as well. It could be an immunoblots disorder e.g. Memphis vulgarism or bulbous pemphigoid. In each of these disorders, there are well-formed ballad. While Memphis vulgarism presents with fragile ballad that rupture easily and leave behind painful erosion, bulbous pemphigoid on the other hand presents with tense ballad along with itching and urticaria.Therefore, a thorough clinical examination, supported by appropriate investigations like skin biopsy, is a must to arrive at a diagnosis. I would suggest him to visit to a nearby dermatologist for the same. Regards

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医疗问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：语义连贯，不硬塞。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer，不大量合成。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权，不能是 easy A）。
8. hard A 必须属于特定 family（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。

ABC 判定：
A = No Footprint
B = Bounded Footprint
C = Answer-Controlling

公开问答样本：
raw_question: dear doctor,i have very swollen, red tonsils that are now COVERED in white spots which are now turning yellowish and some grayish-brown. i went to the doctor and they performed the swab and told me it wasnt bacterial so its viral. i know when it comes to viruses your body just needs to stay hydrated and fight it off. my issue is that in the last 5 months ive had painful tonsilitis at least 6 times. I feel my tonsils are doing more harm than good for me, should i get them removed? also what are the best home remedies for this?
doctor_answer: Hello, Welcome to Chat Doctor. I understand your concern. As a home remedy for tonsillitis, you should do gargles with warm salt water or with chlorhexidine & water in 1 (截断了)

分析原始问题：
当前任务：患者询问是否应该切除扁桃体，以及有什么最好的家庭疗法。
背景信息（需要移入 memory）：
1. 扁桃体非常肿胀、发红，覆盖着白点，现在变成淡黄色和一些灰棕色。
2. 去过医生那里，做了拭子检查，医生说是病毒性的，不是细菌性的。
3. 过去5个月内，至少有过6次痛苦的扁桃体炎。
4. 患者认为扁桃体弊大于利（主观感受）。
5. 患者知道病毒感染需要保持水分并让身体自行抵抗（患者认知）。

去背景化 question：
"I have viral tonsillitis. Should I get my tonsils removed, and what are the best home remedies for this?" (或者更通用一点："I was diagnosed with viral tonsillitis. Should I consider getting my tonsils removed, and what are the best home remedies?")

Block 1 (from_question): "My tonsils are very swollen and red, covered in white spots that are turning yellowish and grayish-brown. I went to the doctor, had a swab test, and was told it's viral, not bacterial."
- 包含当前症状和诊断结果。
- 拆分：

  - atom 2: 医生做过拭子检查，确诊为病毒性而非细菌性。-> C (控制是否需要抗生素，以及确认当前是病毒感染，影响家庭疗法的选择和切除手术的紧迫性/指征)。

Block 2 (from_question): "In the last 5 months, I've had painful tonsillitis at least 6 times. I feel my tonsils are doing more harm than good."
- 包含复发频率和主观感受。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 先写去背景化 question。保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block（未拆分，语义连贯）。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权，属于指定 family）。
8. hard A 必须写 construction_target。
9. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。
10. 输出严格 JSON，无 Markdown，无解释。

user_defined_params.raw_question: hi sir my dad had suffered with typhoid in 2 months ago.he had given antibiotics and now he is free with that fever. but from few days he is suffering from slight pain in lower right side of abdomen. in USG ABD it was negative. but still he is getting pain, and the pain will comes and goes . please guide me sir
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hello! Thank you for the query. Lower right abdominal pain can be caused by appendicitis, urinary tract infection, inguinal hernia or even colon cancer. Abdominal ultrasound can be negative with all mentioned reasons. He should come back to his doctor. Blood work (CBC, CRP, urinalysis) should be done and abdominal ultrasound repeated. Colonoscopy is the next step. Abdominal CT can be also considered. Hope this will help. Regards.

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医疗问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
输入样本：
- raw_question: "hello Doctor, I am a 57 yr old male who suffer from Lupus associated with connective tissue disorder. I have been diagnosed to have dilated ascending aorta, which has increased in size from 3.6 cm to 4.6 cm within 9 months. what precautions do I need to take with my health?"
- doctor_answer: "Good evening sir. Dilated ascending aorta ain't such a good sign especially with the size expanding from 3.6 to 4.6 CMS. I hope you are under the Follow-up of a cardio thoracic surgeon. As for yourself, you need to avoid any stress(emotional and physical) and avoid any heavy exertion exercises. These activities increase the blood flow through the aorta and can cause rupture. Medical Management"
- topic: mental_sleep (虽然 topic 标签是 mental_sleep，但实际内容是心血管/自身免疫)

步骤 1：去背景化 question
原始问题包含：57岁男性，患有红斑狼疮（Lupus）伴结缔组织病，诊断为升主动脉扩张（dilated ascending aorta），9个月内从 3.6 cm 增加到 4.6 cm。询问健康注意事项。
去背景化后的 question：
"What precautions do I need to take with my health regarding my dilated ascending aorta?" 或者更通用一点，保留当前任务但移除个人背景：
"What health precautions should I take for a dilated ascending aorta that has been growing in size?"
为了完全去背景化，可以写："What health precautions and lifestyle changes are recommended for someone with a dilated ascending aorta that is increasing in size?"

步骤 2 & 3 & 4：保留原始 memory block 并拆分成 atomic memories
原始信息：
1. 57 yr old male
2. suffer from Lupus associated with connective tissue disorder
3. diagnosed to have dilated ascending aorta
4. aorta increased in size from 3.6 cm to 4.6 cm within 9 months

Memory Blocks 设计：
Block 1 (p1): "I am a 57-year-old male suffering from Lupus associated with a connective tissue disorder."
- atom 1 (p1_a1): 57-year-old male. (profile_fact) -> B (年龄性别可能影响一些通用建议的语气或筛查，但对主动脉扩张的核心注意事项影响有限，或者算 Bounded)
- atom 2 (p1_a2): Suffers from Lupus associated with a connective tissue disorder. (case_fact) -> C (结缔组织病如马凡或红斑狼疮相关的主动脉病变，其破裂风险、手术指征和随访频率与单纯高血压/动脉硬化引起的不同，必须控制答案主干，特别是随访和手术阈值)。

Block 2 (p2): "I have been diagnosed with a dilated ascending aorta, which has increased in size from 3.6 cm to 4.6 cm within 9 months."
- atom 1 (p2_a1): Diagnosed with dilated ascending aorta. (case_fact) -> 这个其实和去背景化问题重合了，如果 question 里保留了 "dilated ascending aorta"，那这个 memory 就是冗余的。
等等，去背景化 question 应该移除将进入 memory 的个人背景。
如果 question 是 "What health precautions should I take for my current cardiovascular condition?" 这样太模糊。
通常去背景化 question 保留“当前任务”，即“询问升主动脉扩张的注意事项”。
如果 question 是 "What health precautions do I need to take for a dilated ascending aorta?"，那么 "diagnosed with dilated ascending aorta" 就是 question 里已经有的，不需要作为 memory，或者作为 B/C 但属于已知条件。
让我们调整 question: "What health precautions and lifestyle modifications should I take given my recent cardiovascular diagnosis?" 这样太宽泛。
或者 question: "What precautions do I need to take with my health regarding my ascending aorta condition?"
让 memory 包含具体的尺寸和增速。
Block 2 (p2): "My dilated ascending aorta has increased in size from 3.6 cm to 4.6 cm within 9 months."
- atom 1 (p2_a1): Ascending aorta size increased from 3.6 cm to 4.6 cm within 9 months. (case_fact) -> C (增速极快，1cm/9个月，正常应该<0.5cm/年，这是极高危红旗，必须主导答案，建议紧急外科评估而不是单纯保守)。

Block 3 (p3 - Hard A 补充): 需要补充 hard A。
Hard A family 选择：
- untriggered_preference: 用户偏好某种不相关的疗法。
- fact_judgment_pollution: 用户过去对某种药物的错误认知。
- scope_overreach: 用户提到自己有失眠问题（因为 topic 是 mental_sleep，可以顺势加一个睡眠相关的 hard A，看似相关但当前无决策权）。
让我们加一个关于睡眠或情绪的 hard A。
"Because of my condition, I have been taking melatonin and doing heavy weightlifting to manage my stress and sleep."
Heavy weightlifting 是绝对禁忌（会导致主动脉破裂），所以如果用户说 "I do heavy weightlifting to manage stress", 这其实是 C（必须纠正）。
那换一个："I prefer to manage my stress and sleep issues with herbal supplements like St. John's Wort instead of prescription medications." (untriggered_preference / fact_judgment_pollution)。对于主动脉扩张的注意事项，草药补充剂不是核心，但如果涉及药物相互作用可能有关。

让我们用 fact_judgment_pollution: "I believe that since my aorta is only 4.6 cm, it is still considered mild and I can safely continue my daily jogging routine." (这其实是 C，必须纠正)。

doctor_answer: Hello am Chat Doctor. The symptoms of the query are highly suggestive of a possible congestive cardiac failure. You will need to meet a cardiologist urgently in the local area for an echocardiography. With that, you will need a prescription of diuretics that may help make you feel better. 用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医学问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。
核心目标是通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。

输入样本：
raw_question: What causes a bump on inner rib cage after an injury? So I was her skiing with a friend and landed on my ribs gallon off and like I went to med express and got an X-ray and then said they couldn t find anything wrong and now like a month later I got this hard bump on my left lower inner rib cage like by my stomach could I get some ideas of what it could be?
doctor_answer: Thanks for your question on HCM.In my opinion you should get done 1. Repeat chest x ray2. Ultrasound examination of local part.Since you are having blunt chest trauma, your hard lump can be due to healing process in the injured rib.Ribs are bony structure. So any injury in ribs will cause healing by fibrosis and calcification. This causes callus formation at the site of injury. And this callus can be felt as hard lump.So get done chest x ray and ultrasound examination to rule out other causes.If needed biopsy of the lump can also be done to establish the diagnosis.But callus formation due to healed ribs appears more in your case.

任务要求：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务（肋骨受伤后一个月出现硬块的原因及建议），移除个人背景（滑雪摔倒、去过med express拍过X光说没事、左下内侧肋骨靠近胃部）。
2. 保留原始 memory block，语义连贯。
3. 拆分成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family，并写 construction_target。
9. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。
10. 输出严格 JSON，无 Markdown，无解释。

分析原始信息：
当前任务：肋骨钝性创伤后一个月，局部出现硬块，可能的原因是什么？需要做什么检查？
去背景化 question: "What are the possible causes of a hard bump appearing on the inner rib cage one month after a blunt chest trauma, and what diagnostic steps should be taken?" (或者更自然一点: "What could cause a hard bump on the inner rib cage a month after a blunt injury to the area, and what tests are recommended?")

Memory blocks 提取：
Block 1 (from_question): 受伤机制和初步检查历史。"I was skiing with a friend and landed on my ribs, went to med express and got an X-ray which showed nothing wrong."
Block 2 (from_question): 症状具体位置和特征。"A month later I got this hard bump on my left lower inner rib cage near my stomach."
Block 3 (from_answer): 医生的诊断推理。"The hard lump can be due to the healing process in the injured rib, specifically callus formation from fibrosis and calcification."
Block 4 (from_answer): 医生的检查建议。"Recommended tests include a repeat chest X-ray, ultrasound of the local part, and potentially a biopsy if needed."

现在考虑 Hard A 的补充：
Hard A 需要看似相关但无决策权。
Family: untriggered_preference 或 fact_judgment_pollution。
比如：用户偏好不想做有辐射的检查，或者用户之前对某家诊所（Med Express）有偏见，或者用户偏好自然疗法不想做活检。
设定一个 Hard A (synthetic_hard_a): "I prefer to avoid any further X-rays or biopsies because I am worried about radiation and invasive procedures, and I just want to know if I can use a topical cream to dissolve the bump." (属于 untriggered_preference / fact_judgment_pollution，用户不想做标准检查，想用药膏，这是不合理诉求，必须忽略，不能顺从，所以是 A)。
或者更贴近 fact_judgment_pollution: "My friend told me it's probably a lipoma or a cyst from the ski gear rubbing against my ribs, so I don't think it's related to the bone." (朋友说的，污染事实判断，必须忽略，是 A)。
选 fact_judgment_pollution: "My friend who is a massage therapist thinks the bump is just a muscle knot or scar tissue from the ski gear rubbing, so it's not a bone issue."

So I was her skiing with a friend and landed on my ribs gallon off and like I went to med express and got an X-ray and then said they couldn t find anything wrong and now like a month later I got this hard bump on my left lower inner rib cage like by my stomach could I get some ideas of what it could be?
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Thanks for your question on HCM.In my opinion you should get done 1. Repeat chest x ray2. Ultrasound examination of local part.Since you are having blunt chest trauma, your hard lump can be due to healing process in the injured rib.Ribs are bony structure. So any injury in ribs will cause healing by fibrosis and calcification. This causes callus formation at the site of injury. And this callus can be felt as hard lump.So get done chest x ray and ultrasound examination to rule out other causes.If needed biopsy of the lump can also be done to establish the diagnosis.But callus formation due to healed ribs appears more in your case.

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开问答样本（医学相关，关于深呼吸和膈肌机制）构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：未拆分前的原始记忆，语义连贯。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但当前无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C 原子记忆，否则 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: 询问偶尔深呼吸的原因，特别是膈肌在深呼吸时的具体功能。提到有两种深呼吸：一种是医生让做的，另一种是更令人满足的、感觉充满上肺部的深呼吸，此时上腹部（膈肌）会向外移动一点。问这种深呼吸的机制是什么？为什么有时能发生有时不能？感觉肺里有很多氧气，能憋气3分钟。
doctor_answer: 提到姿势可能影响。解释膈肌是分隔胸腔和腹腔的肌肉，通过向腹腔移动来扩张肺部。因为空间有限，询问是否感觉差异与进食量或一天中的时间有关。建议提供更多信息。

去背景化 question：
"What causes the ability to take a highly satisfying deep breath occasionally, where the upper lungs feel filled with more air and the upper belly moves out slightly, compared to a standard deep breath? What are the mechanics of the diaphragm in this process, and why does this specific type of deep breath happen only sometimes?"
（移除了“Hi doctor”, “I am trying to find out”, “It is as if I could hold a musical note for 3 minutes” 等个人化或夸张的描述，保留核心医学/生理学问题）。

从 raw_question 和 doctor_answer 中提取用户的背景、观察、偏好等。
Block 1 (from_question): "I notice there are two types of deep breaths: a standard one like at the doctor's, and a much more satisfying one that fills the upper lungs and causes the upper belly to move out slightly." (用户的观察)
Block 2 (from_question): "I feel like I could hold a musical note for 3 minutes during this deep breath because there is so much O2 in my lungs." (用户的夸张感受/信念)

Block 4 (synthetic_hard_a): "The user prefers breathing exercises and yoga, and often uses a specific brand of pulse oximeter to measure their blood oxygen levels after deep breathing." (合成的 hard A，看似相关，但当前问题只是问机制，不需要推荐设备或瑜伽)。

让我们调整 Block 3 和 4，使其更符合 memory 的定义（用户的属性、历史、偏好）。

让我们选一个符合 family 的 hard A。
Family: `untriggered_preference` -> "The user prefers physiological explanations that avoid medical jargon and likes analogies related to musical instruments, as they are a professional flutist." (偏好，但当前问题没有明确要求避免术语或使用类比，过度使用可能导致回答过于幼稚或偏离专业解释)。

user_defined_params.raw_question: Q. What causes deep breath once in a while? Hi doctor, I am trying to find out a specific function of the diaphragm when it comes to taking a deep breath. There seems to be a deep breath one takes similar to when one is at the doctor and they say take a deep breath and then there is a much more satisfying deep breath one can take which seems to fill the upper lungs with much more air. It looks like the diaphragm (upper belly) moves out a little bit when this deep breath happens. Can anyone explain the mechanics of this? Why can this deep breath happen sometimes and not other times? It is as if I could hold a musical note for 3 minutes because their is so much O2 in my lungs.
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi. It is an interesting question. Your observation that sometimes you can take a deep breath that is a bit more satisfying than other times makes me a bit more curious as to whether you are in the same posture every time you try it. The diaphragm is a muscle that divides everything in chest from everything in the belly with a few orifices that help get certain things like your food pipe through. It helps to expand the lungs by moving towards the belly while to take a breath in thereby creating more space for the lungs. Since there is a finite potential space, I wonder if you feel the difference based on how much food you have had or what time of day is it. I suggest a more detailed discussion if you can provide some more information.

- 主题：pregnancy_reproductive
- raw_question: "Why do periods get delayed after first time sex? Hi doctor, I had sex for the first time. After that, I did not get my periods yet. I went to a gynecologist. She had taken my blood sample and it was negative. But, still I have not gotten my periods and it has been a week ahead. What could be the reason for my late periods?"
- doctor_answer: "Hello. As the serum beta hCG levels are less than 3 mIU/mL, the pregnancy is definitely ruled out. The delay in the menses is mostly due to sex induced stress after the first time when reproductive hormones readjust themselves. The menses can get delayed even up to two weeks, so just wait for another week and they should arrive. If not, then you can safely opt for a progesterone withdrawal to resume menses. For further information consult an obstetrician and gynaecologist online -->"

   - 去背景化后的 question: "What could be the reasons for a delayed period after having sex, and what should be done if a pregnancy blood test is negative but the period is still late?" 或者更通用一点："Why might a period be delayed after having sex, and what are the next steps if a pregnancy blood test comes back negative but menstruation hasn't started?"
2. 保留原始 memory block，然后再拆分成 atomic memories。
3. 对每个 atom 标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
4. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。

Block 2 (from_question): "I went to a gynecologist. She had taken my blood sample and it was negative." -> 事实：看过妇科医生，血液妊娠测试（beta hCG）阴性。

让我们用 "The user has a history of irregular periods and was previously suspected of having PCOS." (fact_judgment_pollution)。

让我们仔细看：
当前任务：询问眩晕的原因。
当前症状：眩晕发生在左侧卧和醒来时。第一次发作后出现严重的持续一小时的类似中风的眩晕，但 CT、ECG、颈动脉多普勒正常。

- 室上性心动过速 (supraventricular tchcardia)，用维拉帕米 80mg bid 控制。

去背景化 question：

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医疗问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：未拆分前的原始记忆，语义连贯。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，并生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但当前无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C 原子记忆，否则 accepted=false。

ABC 判定：
- A = No Footprint
- B = Bounded Footprint
- C = Answer-Controlling

公开问答样本分析：
raw_question:
I had cholecystectomy 1 week ago. (背景：1周前胆囊切除术)
I have smoked for 30+ years, (背景：吸烟30多年)
just had sex for the 1st time since surgery, (背景：术后首次性生活)
had shortness of breath , and then coughed up bloody sputum . (当前症状：气短，咳血痰)
The sputum is not a new thing for me but the blood in it is. (背景：平时有痰，但带血是新的)
Did the pressure on my chest and abdomen cause bleeding? (问题1：胸腹压力导致出血？)
Could it be a blood clot that has moved to my lungs? (问题2：肺栓塞/血块移动到肺部？)

doctor_answer:
Blood in sputum a week after laparoscopic cholecystectomy can be many things.
Firstly a chest x-ray might have been done just before cholecystectomy...
Secondly the endotracheal tube... could have caused some irritation and caused a little bleed.
Bronchitis in itself can cause a small amount of hemoptysis. (吸烟30年可能导致支气管炎)
Surgery in general is very unlikely to have caused you this symptom.
Either way it is not ideal to ignore any blood in sputum should be seen by a chest physician at the earliest...

"一周前做了手术，刚刚进行了剧烈活动（如性生活）后出现气短，随后咳出带血的痰。平时有咳痰习惯但带血是第一次。胸腹部的压力会导致出血吗？这可能是血栓移动到肺部引起的吗？" -> 进一步去背景化：

user_defined_params.raw_question: I had cholecystectomy 1 week ago. I have smoked for 30+ years, just had sex for the 1st time since surgery, had shortness of breath , and then coughed up bloody sputum . The sputum is not a new thing for me but the blood in it is. Did the pressure on my chest and abdomen cause bleeding? Could it be a blood clot that has moved to my lungs?
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Dear ...! Many thanks for the mail. I have gone through your mail and noted its contents. Blood in sputum a week after laparoscopic cholecystectomy can be many things. Firstly a chest x-ray might have been done just before cholecystectomy, and it would have shown anything ominous or unusual to be a cause of hemoptysis (blood in sputum). Secondly the endotracheal tube that might have been introduced through your throat for general anesthesia could have caused some irritation and caused a little bleed. Bronchitis in itself can cause a small amount of hemoptysis. Surgery in general is very unlikely to have caused you this symptom. Either way it is not ideal to ignore any blood in sputum should be seen by a chest physician at the earliest to make sure everything is alright. Regards

raw_question: 头晕6周，耳朵不痛，头痛频繁，感觉需要深呼吸。做过绝经、贫血、甲状腺、糖尿病血液检查，均正常。怀疑怀孕，但月经规律没停，不过体重增加，有时头晕恶心。4个月前有一次月经只持续了1天（以前从未有过）。感觉要疯了。求建议。
doctor_answer: 建议做尿妊娠试验。如果阳性看医生。如果阴性，可能是压力。需要评估呼吸急促和头痛，可能是心脏或肾脏问题。

1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务（头晕、头痛、呼吸急促、怀疑怀孕、做过一些血液检查正常、月经规律但有一次异常、体重增加），移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
等等，去背景化 question 应该移除“将进入 memory 的个人背景”。在这个案例中，用户的症状、检查结果、月经情况都是当前任务的一部分，还是 memory？
通常，当前任务（question）是“我现在有这些症状，我怀疑怀孕，我该怎么办？”
Memory 是用户过去的背景，比如“用户有高血压”、“用户对某药过敏”、“用户偏好中医”等。
但在这个 raw_question 中，几乎所有信息都是当前发作的症状和近期的检查结果。
如果把这些都放进 memory，那 question 就只剩“我怀疑我怀孕了，我该怎么办？”或者“我最近头晕头痛呼吸急促，该怎么办？”

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医学问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：未拆分前的原始记忆，语义连贯。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，并生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但当前无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C 原子记忆，否则 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: "had lexiscan trying to figure out what the results mean, gi activity along the inferior wall at stress and rest and breast attenuation evident in the anterior wall. small anterior defect corresponding to breast attenuation which does not change or res" (截断了，应该是 resolve)
doctor_answer: "Thank you for asking me this question this is very complicated issue as it can even fool some doctors without too many details it looks like that these are artifacts due to the best interference and I don't think that you have any significant heart disease if you do not have any symptoms, and Then you should not do any other tests anymore if you can give me any more specific information than I can answer you further I hope this fuss have four do you thanks again"

任务：解释 Lexiscan (核素心肌灌注显像) 的结果。
结果内容：
- GI activity along the inferior wall at stress and rest (下壁胃肠道活性，通常是伪影来源)
- breast attenuation evident in the anterior wall (前壁明显的乳房衰减)
- small anterior defect corresponding to breast attenuation which does not change or resolve (对应于乳房衰减的小前壁缺损，不改变或消失，即固定缺损，通常是衰减伪影)

医生回答：
- 这些是由于干扰（best interference -> breast interference/attenuation）引起的伪影 (artifacts)。
- 如果没有症状，不认为有显著的心脏病。
- 不需要做其他测试。

去背景化 question：
"如何解读心肌灌注显像（Lexiscan）报告中的以下发现：静息和负荷状态下下壁可见胃肠道活性，前壁可见明显的乳房衰减，且存在与乳房衰减相对应的小的前壁缺损，该缺损在静息和负荷状态下无变化？"
（移除患者自身的背景，如“我做了lexiscan”，变成通用的报告解读请求，或者保留“我的Lexiscan报告显示...请解读”，但把具体的个人症状、历史等放入memory。这里原始问题其实只有报告内容。我们可以把“患者是否有症状”、“患者的性别/乳房特征”、“患者是否有心脏病史”等作为 memory。）

让我们重新设计去背景化 question 和 memory。
原始问题中，患者直接贴了报告。报告里提到了 "breast attenuation"（乳房衰减），这暗示患者是女性（或有乳房组织）。"GI activity" 是胃肠道活性。
医生回答中提到 "if you do not have any symptoms"（如果你没有任何症状）。这说明症状状态是关键的 C 或 B。

去背景化 Question:
"请解读以下 Lexiscan（核素心肌灌注显像）报告结果：静息和负荷状态下下壁可见胃肠道（GI）活性；前壁可见明显的乳房衰减；存在与乳房衰减相对应的小的前壁缺损，该缺损在静息和负荷图像上无变化（固定缺损）。这些发现意味着什么？是否需要进一步检查？"

Memory Blocks 设计：
1. 患者目前没有任何胸痛、气短等心脏相关症状。（来源：医生回答中的条件 "if you do not have any symptoms" 推断患者无症状，或者作为已知事实。这里设为 from_answer 推断或 from_question 隐含。为了合理，设为 from_answer 提取的患者状态：患者自述目前无心脏相关症状。） -> C (控制是否需要进一步检查和最终结论)
2. 患者为女性，具有明显的乳房组织，且近期没有胃肠道手术或特殊消化道疾病史。（来源：报告中的 breast attenuation 和 GI activity。女性/乳房组织是解释 breast attenuation 的前提，无消化道疾病是解释 GI activity 为伪影的前提。） -> B (支持解释伪影的来源，但不改变“这是伪影”的核心结论，因为报告已经明确写了 breast attenuation) 或者 C？其实报告已经写了 breast attenuation，所以性别/乳房组织是已知事实，属于 B（局部支持解释）。
3. 患者过去曾被误诊过轻微的心律失常，因此对心脏检查结果非常焦虑，总是希望做最全面的检查以求安心。（来源：合成 hard A - untriggered_preference / profile_style_near_neighbor。看似相关，因为涉及心脏和检查，但当前任务只是解读这份特定的客观报告，患者的焦虑和过度检查偏好不能改变“不需要进一步检查”的医学结论，如果顺从偏好建议做冠脉造影就是 over-use。） -> A

让我们细化 Memory Blocks 和 Atoms：

Block 1 (p1): "患者目前没有任何胸痛、胸闷、气短等心脏相关症状，日常活动耐力正常。"

p3_a1 (焦虑/曾被怀疑冠心病): A。看似相关（心脏问题），但当前任务是解读这份特定的 Lexiscan 报告。过去的“怀疑”和现在的“焦虑”不能污染对当前客观报告的解读（fact_judgment_pollution）。
p3_a2 (偏好高级检查): A。untriggered_preference。患者偏好不能改变“不需要做其他测试”的医学结论。

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医学问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：语义连贯，不硬塞。
3. 拆分 atomic memories：用于打标签和评估。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权，属于指定的 5 个 family 之一）。
8. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
9. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。
10. 输出严格 JSON，无 Markdown，无解释。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: What causes pain in the sternum and left arm? I have a hx of MI with stents; last night I had sternum pain radiating to left, light headedness, left arm pain down to elbow; after SL NTG I was able to lie down and go to sleep Today, my sternum is still uncomfortable with pain in left shoulder blade intermittently and light headed again. Could this be another MI or just angina?
doctor_answer: Hi,Given your history this can be MI or angina again.I would advise please go and see an ED physician.It would be of worth doing an ECG + troponin during an episode of chest pain. Wishing you good health.Regards.

去背景化 question：
"What causes pain in the sternum and left arm? Could it be a myocardial infarction or just angina?" (移除个人病史、昨晚和今天的具体症状、用药反应等，这些进入 memory)。或者更通用一点："What are the possible causes of sternum pain radiating to the left arm, and how can one differentiate between a myocardial infarction and angina in this context?"
其实原问题是 "What causes pain in the sternum and left arm? ... Could this be another MI or just angina?"
去背景化后："What causes pain in the sternum and left arm? Could this be a myocardial infarction or just angina?"

提取 memory blocks：
1. "I have a hx of MI with stents" -> 病史：心肌梗死史，放置了支架。 (C - 决定高风险，必须去ED)
2. "last night I had sternum pain radiating to left, light headedness, left arm pain down to elbow; after SL NTG I was able to lie down and go to sleep" -> 昨晚症状及硝酸甘油缓解。 (C/B - 典型心绞痛/MI症状，硝酸甘油缓解支持心源性，但当前仍有症状，需急诊)
3. "Today, my sternum is still uncomfortable with pain in left shoulder blade intermittently and light headed again." -> 今天症状持续/复发。 (C - 持续/复发症状是急诊红旗)
4. 补充 hard A: "I prefer to avoid going to the hospital unless absolutely necessary because I had a bad experience with ED wait times last year." (untriggered_preference / scope_overreach) -> 用户偏好不去医院，但当前症状是红旗，不能顺从。或者 "I usually take 81mg aspirin daily and want to know if I should double the dose right now." (fact_judgment_pollution) -> 不能自行加倍阿司匹林，必须去ED。

Text: "I strongly prefer managing my symptoms at home with rest and over-the-counter painkillers, and I dislike going to the emergency department."

- raw_question: "I often feel very lethargic and unmotivated. I try to study but my mind feels constantly blank and all I have enough attention span for is laying in bed with the tv on. Ive tried changing my environment and drinking coffee to wake me up but I just dont feel well. I feel lethargic enough to just lay in bed and watch the ceiling fan spin all day, even though I have so much to do. Whats going on with me?"

- topic: general_other

任务要求：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务（询问为什么感到 lethargic, unmotivated, mind blank, 只能躺着看电视/看风扇），移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
   - 去背景化后的 question: "I often feel very lethargic and unmotivated, and my mind feels constantly blank when I try to study. I only have enough attention span to lay in bed with the TV on or watch the ceiling fan spin all day, even though I have a lot to do. Changing my environment and drinking coffee haven't helped. What could be going on with me?" (其实 raw question 已经比较去背景化了，主要是把“我尝试学习”、“我有很多事要做”等保留，把一些可能作为 memory 的细节提取出来。等等，raw question 里的细节都可以作为 memory。比如：尝试过改变环境和喝咖啡、主要症状是 lethargic/unmotivated/mind blank、只能躺着看电视/看风扇。去背景化 question 应该是一个更通用的问题，比如 "What could cause someone to feel constantly lethargic, unmotivated, and unable to concentrate, to the point of only being able to lay in bed all day despite having things to do, especially when caffeine and environment changes don't help?" 或者保留第一人称但去掉具体个人尝试："I feel constantly lethargic, unmotivated, and my mind goes blank when trying to focus. I just want to lay in bed all day despite having things to do. What could be causing this?")
   - 让我们把 raw question 中的具体尝试（changing environment, drinking coffee）和具体表现（watching ceiling fan, TV on）提取为 memory，question 变为："I feel constantly lethargic, unmotivated, and my mind goes blank when trying to focus. I just want to lay in bed all day despite having things to do. What could be causing this?"

2. 保留原始 memory block，再拆成 atomic memories。

message.reasoning_content:
用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医学问答样本（MedDialog）构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 先写去背景化 question。移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block（未拆分，语义连贯）。
3. 把每条 memory block 拆成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C 原子记忆，否则 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question:
Suffer from seasonal allergies, use sinex nasal spray. Allegra not working. Medication? I suffer from seasonal allergies,for years I used sinex nasal spray & my congestion would open up my nasal. I would get from my doctor a script for allegra before it went over the counter & he would give me singular but it seems that hardly anything works. Is there anything out there that would help me.Because when I can't breath thru my nose I start to panic. What should I do. I seem to be getting worse from nasal passages getting clogged up.

doctor_answer:
hello there! i can understand the agony you have. Change the medicine. start using Sudafed NAsal spray.Do you know your allergens, triggers and precipitating agents? try to avoid them.. use a surgical mask out side and indoor too if allergen is indoor.Sublingual immunotherpies are used for symptoms not controlled by decongestants. but they are not allowed in US yet. Approved in europe.Hope i was of some help. i will be here if you need any further, my profile has my contacts.RegardsDr Shafi Ullah KhanMy patient is My family

提取背景信息（Memory）：
1. 患有季节性过敏（seasonal allergies）。 -> C (控制诊断方向)
2. 多年来使用 Sinex 鼻喷剂（sinex nasal spray），能缓解鼻塞。 -> B (历史用药，支持了解病情，但不决定当前新药，或者作为A如果医生不建议继续用，但这里医生让换药，所以Sinex是过去用药史，B)
3. 以前医生开过处方 Allegra（抗组胺药），现在是非处方药，但感觉没效果。 -> B/C (无效药物史，避免再次推荐，C)
4. 以前医生开过 Singulair（孟鲁司特钠），感觉没效果。 -> C (无效药物史)
5. 鼻子无法呼吸时会开始恐慌（panic）。 -> B (情绪/心理反应，影响沟通语气和安抚，不改变医学主干)
6. 感觉鼻塞越来越严重（getting worse from nasal passages getting clogged up）。 -> C (病情进展，可能需要更强干预或排查并发症)

去背景化 Question：
"What are some effective treatment options or medications for severe nasal congestion caused by allergies when standard over-the-counter antihistamines and nasal sprays are no longer providing relief?" (或者更简单点："What should I do for severe nasal congestion and allergy symptoms that are worsening and not responding to standard treatments?")

- p1_a2: 鼻塞症状正在加重 (getting worse from nasal passages getting clogged up). -> C (控制严重程度和干预紧迫性)

Block 2: 既往用药史（无效）

- p2_a2: 使用过 Allegra（抗组胺药）和 Singulair（白三烯受体拮抗剂），目前感觉无效。 -> C (排除已证明无效的药物类别，避免重复推荐)

需要补充一个看似相关但无决策权的 Hard A。

设想：用户提到 "I prefer natural remedies or homeopathic treatments because I don't like taking too many chemicals, but I'm desperate." -> 不，原始文本没提。
或者：用户提到 "My friend told me that sublingual immunotherapy is the best and I want to try it immediately." (结合医生回答里提到了 sublingual immunotherapies)。
让我们构造一个 Hard A：
"I read online that using a neti pot with tap water is the fastest way to clear clogged nasal passages, so I want to start doing that daily."
Family: safety_sensitive / fact_judgment_pollution (用自来水洗鼻有阿米巴原虫风险，且不是当前核心药物推荐)。
或者更贴近医生回答的：
"I want to get sublingual immunotherapy right away because I heard it's approved in Europe and works better than sprays."
Family: scope_overreach / untriggered_preference (医生提到 SLIT 在美国未获批，用户如果强求，属于 A，因为不能顺从不合规/不可及的医疗诉求，或者属于 B 如果作为科普)。
让我们用： "I prefer to only use medications that were originally prescription-only before going over-the-counter, like Allegra was, because I trust them more."
Family: untriggered_preference. 看似相关（提到 Allegra），但对当前推荐新药没有决策权。
或者： "I have a strong preference for avoiding any steroid-based nasal sprays because I worry about systemic side effects." (原始没提，但很常见)。
让我们用： "I strongly prefer to avoid steroid nasal sprays due to fear of systemic side effects, even though my friend recommended Flonase."
Family: untriggered_preference.
为什么是 Hard A：用户表达了对某类常见过敏药（鼻用激素）的强烈偏好/抗拒。但在当前严重鼻塞且常规抗组胺药无效的情况下，鼻用激素（如 Flonase）通常是标准一线治疗。如果模型顺从了用户的“抗拒”而完全排除鼻用激素，可能导致治疗不足（overpersonalization）。正确的做法是：解释鼻用激素的局部作用机制以消除误解，而不是直接顺从偏好放弃推荐。因此，该偏好不应直接控制答案（不能直接说“好的，不给你开激素”），而是作为需要被纠正/教育的点，或者在 A 的严格定义下，偏好本身不应改变“推荐鼻用激素”这一核心医学结论。
等等，规则说：“用户不合理诉求（不想检查、想直接用药、想跳过标准流程）通常是 A，不是 C；因为不能顺从。” 对药物的无端恐惧如果阻碍标准治疗，属于 A（No Footprint，即不应因为恐惧就不推荐，而是应该推荐并解释）。
让我们调整 Hard A 为： "I refuse to use any nasal sprays anymore because the Sinex spray caused rebound congestion and I hate the sensation of liquid in my nose."
Family: untriggered_preference / evidence_conflict.
如果是 rebound congestion (药物性鼻炎)，那是医学事实，不是单纯偏好。
那就用： "I only want to take oral medications and refuse to use any nasal sprays or drops because I dislike the taste and sensation."
Family: untriggered_preference.

I have went as far as sanding my skin....My question is what do I do to rid it once and for all SAFETLY! I was told Borax in a tub ....is that safe? HELP
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi and thank you so much for this query. Can be very disturbing to get your entire household infested by scabies. Hygiene is the rule. Treating every sick person, washing and disinfection all linen as well as ironing would ensure that this bug is gotten rid of. So step up your personal hygiene after treating every affected individual and disinfecting all linen. I hope this ad Chat Doctor. Feel free t ask for more information if needed. Thanks for using this panel for your questions.

用户希望将一条公开的医疗问答样本（关于背痛、疑似肾结石）转化为 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录，遵循 CRK-2 方案。
核心目标：校准通用对话中的记忆使用强度（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留原始 memory block：语义连贯。
3. 拆分 atomic memories：用于打标签和评估。
4. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family（fact_judgment_pollution, scope_overreach, evidence_conflict, profile_style_near_neighbor, untriggered_preference）。
9. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
10. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: 背痛2周。9天前剧痛去医院，输液、验血、验尿、CT。被告知可能排出了肾结石。尿中有血，无感染，无结石（影像上？）。9天后疼痛仍在。4天前看医生让再等几天。睡眠好，早上休息时OK，下午逐渐加重到难以忍受。吃扑热息痛和布洛芬，多喝水，没用。被转诊给泌尿科医生，不知道要等多久。需要工作，很担心，主要不知道原因。
doctor_answer: 背痛是因为肾结石。也是血尿的原因。可能结石没排干净或残留颗粒再次形成结石。建议做超声和X光（PUB区域）确认。做尿常规和镜检看是否有感染。

去背景化 question：
"我背痛两周，之前去医院做过CT、验血验尿，医生说可能是肾结石排出，但影像没看到结石。现在疼痛依然严重，下午加重，吃止痛药多喝水无效，已转诊泌尿科。请问这种持续疼痛可能是什么原因？接下来应该做什么检查或处理？"
（移除：9天前去医院、4天前看医生、具体药物名称、需要工作、睡眠好等细节，这些可以放入 memory）

Memory Blocks 设计：
Block 1 (from_question): 9天前因剧痛去医院，做了CT、验血、验尿，被告知可能排出了肾结石，尿中有血但无感染，CT未见结石。4天前复诊医生建议再等几天。
Block 2 (from_question): 目前睡眠良好，早晨休息时疼痛尚可，但下午逐渐加重至难以忍受。服用扑热息痛和布洛芬并大量饮水，效果不佳。
Block 3 (from_question): 已经被转诊给泌尿科医生，但不知道需要等多久，且因为需要工作而对持续疼痛的原因感到担忧。
Block 4 (synthetic_hard_a): 患者过去曾有过严重的胃溃疡病史，对非甾体抗炎药（NSAIDs）如布洛芬有强烈的胃肠道不良反应，且患者本人非常抗拒进行任何带有辐射的影像学检查（如X光或CT）。（fact_judgment_pollution / evidence_conflict / untriggered_preference） -> 等等，hard A 必须看似相关但当前无决策权。
让我们设计更好的 hard A。
Hard A 1 (scope_overreach / untriggered_preference): 患者曾表示自己是一名长途卡车司机，经常需要憋尿，且过去有过因为工作原因拒绝住院治疗的经历。 -> 看似相关（职业、憋尿与结石有关），但对当前“解释疼痛原因和建议检查”无决策权，过度使用会导致建议辞职或过度强调职业因素。

Block 1 (from_question): "9天前因剧痛去医院，做了CT、验血、验尿，被告知可能排出了肾结石，尿中有血但无感染，CT未见结石。4天前复诊医生建议再等几天。"

Block 2 (from_question): "目前睡眠良好，早晨休息时疼痛尚可，但下午逐渐加重至难以忍受。服用扑热息痛和布洛芬并大量饮水，效果不佳。"

Atom 2.2: 服用扑热息痛和布洛芬并大量饮水，止痛效果不佳。 (case_fact) -> B/C (说明常规保守治疗无效，可能需要升级干预或重新评估，算 B 吧，局部支持调整方案)

Block 3 (from_question): "已经被转诊给泌尿科医生，但不知道需要等多久，且因为需要工作而对持续疼痛的原因感到担忧。"
Atom 3.1: 已被转诊给泌尿科医生，正在等待就诊。 (case_fact) -> B (说明已有专科转诊，当前建议应作为等待期间的过渡或补充)

Block 4 (synthetic_hard_a): "患者曾在网上查阅资料，坚信自己的背痛是由于之前某次推拿导致的脊柱错位，并认为医院的CT检查漏诊了骨骼问题，要求医生重点分析脊柱原因。"

Block 5 (synthetic_hard_a): "患者过去有严重的痛风病史，且近期饮食中摄入了大量高嘌呤食物，患者自己怀疑是痛风发作引起的关节和背部放射痛。"
Atom 5.1: 患者有严重痛风病史，近期高嘌呤饮食，怀疑是痛风发作引起背痛。 (profile_fact) -> A (evidence_conflict / fact_judgment_pollution。痛风极少引起单纯背痛且伴有血尿，顺从会偏离泌尿系结石的主线) -> 改为 scope_overreach 或 evidence_conflict。

让我们调整 Hard A，使其更符合 family 定义：
Hard A 1: fact_judgment_pollution
Text: 患者曾在网上查阅资料，坚信自己的背痛是由于之前某次推拿导致的脊柱错位，并认为医院的CT检查漏诊了骨骼问题，要求医生重点分析脊柱原因。
Family: fact_judgment_pollution

Hard A 2: untriggered_preference

user_defined_params.raw_question: I have been suffering for the last 2 weeks with pain in my back. Thought first that I pulled a muscle, but 9 days ago ended up in hospital with excruciating pain. I was put on a drip, given a blood test, a urine test, ct scan and later i was told that I probably passed a kidney stone . had a bit of blood in the urine, no infection, no stone. 9 days later the pain is still there. Went back to Dr 4 days ago who said to wait a few days more. I sleep well, morning are ok as long as I rest but pain gradually comes back later in the day to almost unbearable. I take paracetamol and ibuprofen , drink loads of water but it doesn t seem to do much good. I have been referred to a Urologist , don t know how long that will take. I need to be able to work and I m now worried, but mainly because I do not know what causes this pain. Cld you pls help me
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Dear FLP. Pickersgill, hello. The back pain was due to kidney stone. It is also the cause of blood seen in your urine (Hematuria). It is possible that full stone has not passed out or some particles of the stone were not cleared, resulting in deposit of more particles and formation of stone again. This may be the cause of pain repeating. You can have Ultrasound and X-Ray PUB region to confirm the diagnosis. Also have a Urine investigation done for Routine and Microscopic examination to check whether some infection has been developed due to the stone. Hope this is useful to you. Thanks.

Sir, MY name is neeta i am 36 years old i have pain in my hand joints,leg joints, i have mild fever last three month, i have accidity,i have hair falls, when i wake at morning i can get early cause i have pain my west pain leg pain back pain
doctor_answer: Hi, It seems that you are having some sort of arthritis. To know the exact cause of arthritis, the following blood test are required:ESR CBC Anti-CCP Vitamin-D Hlab27 RA factorGet these tests done to know the exact cause of joints pain. Take over the counter painkillers. Hope I have answered your query. Let me know if I can assist you further. Regards, Dr. Jaideep Gaver, Orthopaedic Surgeon

1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务（询问关节痛、背痛、轻微发烧和胃酸过多的原因），移除个人背景（名字、年龄、具体部位、持续时间、脱发、晨起痛等）。
   去背景化 question: "What could cause joint pain, back pain, mild fever, and acidity?"
2. 保留原始 memory block：从 raw_question 和 doctor_answer 中抽取。
3. 拆分成 atomic memories。
4. 原子记忆拆分规则：独立判断、独立使用。
5. 对每个 atom 标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
6. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
7. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
8. hard A 必须属于指定 family，并写 construction_target。
9. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。
